title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin's next halving will force miner revenue compression with no Fed backstop, as rate hikes remain locked out and the monetary base stops expanding by design. 

At US close, Bitcoin trades at seventy-eight thousand nine hundred ninety-one, up point three percent on the day with support holding near seventy-five thousand. Fear and Greed sits at seventy-one in greed territory. Hashrate has reached nine hundred sixty-four EH per second, confirming sustained network security.
